head_commit.message: V256 MESIN-DEAL-ODDS: deep-screening 3Commas & Trade Ideas (dokumentasi resmi) — (A) mesin deal ala DCA-bot: rencana deal pra-registrasi per sasaran (safety orders maxSO/deviasi-ATR×multiplier/volume×multiplier + avg + TP-dari-avg, Move SL to Breakeven 60%, Trailing TP 0.8×ATR) semuanya DINILAI MEDAN saat matang (ilmu.deal: SO kena/net-dengan-SO/BEP menyelamatkan/ekstra trailing); (B) OddsMaker 0-100 (40% MC + 25% zona + 20% metakognisi + 15% daya) + Money Machine top-3 menguasai kuota ARAH, sisanya ditolak ber-alasan odds; (C) 6 tag peristiwa event-based disegel & hit-rate-nya dinilai medan (ilmu.peristiwa); (D) Global Max Open Positions guard mengikat (24); laporan/odds.json baru; registri 81→101 param bernama [skip ci]
